name: KIVU Golden Path Test
description: Verifies login, opportunities browsing, project application, and student wallet view.

planSteps.description: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8001/login and log in using talent@kivu.id / password
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8001/student/opportunities and click view on the first project
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8001/student/wallet and assert balance displays correctly
Assert that dashboard or student wallet loads without 500 error
